page: OVHcloud c3-8 is a compute-optimized virtual instance powered by the AMD EPYC processor family on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 4 physical cores running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz with 1 thread per core. System memory is configured at 8.0 GB of RAM, creating a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance incorporates 100 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and operates without an attached discrete GPU.

Benchmark measurements indicate strong single-core computational execution, placing the instance in the top 25% with a stress-ng single-core rating of 3076.85 and Geekbench text processing score of 2567.0. Multi-core throughput remains in the middle 50% tier, recording 12235.05 in stress-ng and 5993.0 in Geekbench multi-core tests. Instruction set support includes AES, SHA-NI, and BMI2, which assist in cryptographic tasks and software compilation. Conversely, PassMark memory performance scored in the lower 25% at 1832.39, and static web serving throughput reached 4.61 GB/sec.

The inclusion of dedicated physical cores eliminates hyperthreading contention, delivering predictable execution cycles across processing tasks. The integrated 100 GB local NVMe storage provides rapid storage access, supporting 9.96 million Redis SET operations per second. However, the 8.0 GB memory envelope introduces tradeoffs for memory-intensive operations, as reflected in medium 7B model prompt processing speeds of 21.67 tokens per second. The c3-8 instance provides balanced cost efficiency for CPU-focused workloads, such as CI/CD compilation pipelines, text analytics, batch data transformation, and dedicated background processing.
description: OVHcloud c3-8 is a compute-optimized instance featuring 4 dedicated AMD EPYC physical cores running at 2.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, the instance maintains a 1:2 compute-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core, bundled with 100 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and no discrete GPU. In benchmark evaluations, the c3-8 achieves strong single-core CPU throughput, placing in the top quartile for stress-ng single-core workloads and Geekbench text processing. Multi-core processing, compression, and compilation benchmarks deliver stable middle-tier performance, while PassMark memory throughput and web serving bandwidth perform in the lower quartile. The dedicated core model avoids hyperthreading contention, delivering consistent execution for compute-bound tasks. This server profile suits software build pipelines, CI/CD workflows, small data transformations, and dedicated worker processes requiring predictable CPU allocation without massive memory requirements.
